purpose: Dashboard-only plain-English wording, keyed by the IDs in metric_definitions.json. It is deliberately NOT fingerprinted into runs, so it can be reworded without breaking run comparison. It never defines a metric: populations, formulas and semantics live in metric_definitions.json, which the dashboard shows as secondary technical detail.

audiences.summary: Shown on the main dashboard to every viewer.
audiences.developer: Shown only in Diagnostics, Individual Result evidence details, and technical sections.

compliance.label: Compliance decisioning
compliance.description: Checks whether the employee met each compliance requirement. The system answers PASS, FAIL (a breach), or UNCLEAR.

extraction.label: Structured extraction
extraction.description: Checks whether the system located key facts in the call, such as client ID, date of birth, product and currency.

compliance.decision_coverage.label: Decision coverage
compliance.decision_coverage.what: How often does the system make a clear PASS or FAIL decision?
compliance.decision_coverage.important: A high value means more checks can be handled automatically. It does not say whether those decisions are correct.

compliance.abstention_rate.label: Abstention rate
compliance.abstention_rate.what: How often does the analysis complete successfully but return UNCLEAR instead of a PASS/FAIL decision?
compliance.abstention_rate.calculation: UNCLEAR results from successful analyses ÷ all compliance checks.
compliance.abstention_rate.important: Technical failures are not counted as abstentions, even when they also show UNCLEAR.

compliance.prediction_failure_rate.label: Prediction failure rate
compliance.prediction_failure_rate.what: How often does the pipeline fail to produce a usable result because of an error or invalid output?
compliance.prediction_failure_rate.important: This measures reliability, not uncertainty. Lower is better.

compliance.unexpected_not_applicable_rat.label: Unexpected N/A rate
compliance.unexpected_not_applicable_rat.what: How often did the system mark a compliance check as not applicable?
compliance.unexpected_not_applicable_rat.calculation: Checks marked N/A ÷ all compliance checks.
compliance.unexpected_not_applicable_rat.important: Every check is meant to apply in this evaluation, so this should be 0.

compliance.binary_accuracy.label: Binary accuracy
compliance.binary_accuracy.what: When the system makes a PASS/FAIL decision, how often is it correct?
compliance.binary_accuracy.calculation: Correct PASS/FAIL decisions ÷ all PASS/FAIL decisions.
compliance.binary_accuracy.important: UNCLEAR results and technical failures are excluded. Read it together with Decision coverage.

compliance.breach_precision.label: Breach precision
compliance.breach_precision.what: When the system flags a breach (FAIL), how often is it genuinely a breach?
compliance.breach_precision.calculation: Correct FAIL decisions ÷ all FAIL decisions.
compliance.breach_precision.important: Lower precision means more false alarms for reviewers. Shown as — when the system made no FAIL decision.

compliance.breach_recall.label: Breach recall
compliance.breach_recall.what: Of the actual breaches where the system made a PASS/FAIL decision, how many did it catch?
compliance.breach_recall.calculation: Actual breaches flagged FAIL ÷ actual breaches that received a PASS/FAIL decision.
compliance.breach_recall.important: Lower recall means more real breaches are being missed and marked PASS, so they would never reach a reviewer. Read it together with Breach precision, which shows the false alarms.

compliance.confusion_matrix.label: Decision matrix
compliance.confusion_matrix.what: How the system's PASS/FAIL decisions line up with the ground truth.
compliance.confusion_matrix.calculation: Counts only the checks that received a PASS/FAIL decision.
compliance.confusion_matrix.important: UNCLEAR results and failures are not in the matrix. Breach outcomes covers every actual breach.

compliance.automatic_breach_detection_ra.label: Automatic breach detection
compliance.automatic_breach_detection_ra.what: Across all actual breaches, how many were automatically flagged as FAIL?
compliance.automatic_breach_detection_ra.calculation: Actual breaches flagged FAIL ÷ all actual breaches.
compliance.automatic_breach_detection_ra.important: Unlike Breach recall, breaches that ended UNCLEAR or failed technically stay in the count, so this is the stricter, end-to-end measure.

compliance.false_clearance_rate.label: False-clearance rate
compliance.false_clearance_rate.what: Of all actual breaches, how many were incorrectly marked as compliant (PASS)?
compliance.false_clearance_rate.calculation: Actual breaches marked PASS ÷ all actual breaches.

compliance.gold_breach_abstention_rate.label: Breaches left UNCLEAR
compliance.gold_breach_abstention_rate.what: Of all actual breaches, how many ended UNCLEAR instead of receiving a decision?
compliance.gold_breach_abstention_rate.calculation: Actual breaches with an UNCLEAR result ÷ all actual breaches.

compliance.gold_breach_prediction_failur.label: Breaches lost to failures
compliance.gold_breach_prediction_failur.what: Of all actual breaches, how many could not be assessed because the pipeline failed?
compliance.gold_breach_prediction_failur.calculation: Actual breaches with a prediction failure ÷ all actual breaches.

compliance.gold_breach_unexpected_not_ap.label: Breaches marked N/A
compliance.gold_breach_unexpected_not_ap.what: Of all actual breaches, how many were marked not applicable?
compliance.gold_breach_unexpected_not_ap.calculation: Actual breaches marked N/A ÷ all actual breaches.

compliance.evidence_precision.label: Evidence precision
compliance.evidence_precision.what: Of the transcript turns the model selected as evidence, how much matched the expected evidence?
compliance.evidence_precision.calculation: Averaged per check: matching turns ÷ turns selected.
compliance.evidence_precision.important: Use: shows whether the model cites turns it did not need. Low precision means unrelated turns are cited, which adds noise for reviewers. When no evidence is expected, citing nothing scores 100% and citing anything scores 0%.

compliance.evidence_recall.label: Evidence recall
compliance.evidence_recall.what: Of the expected evidence turns, how many did the model select?
compliance.evidence_recall.calculation: Averaged per check: matching turns ÷ expected turns.
compliance.evidence_recall.important: Use: shows whether the model finds the turns that support its answer. Low recall means key turns are being overlooked, so a reviewer may not see what the result rests on. When no evidence is expected, citing nothing scores 100% and citing anything scores 0%.

compliance.evidence_exact_set_match.label: Exact evidence match
compliance.evidence_exact_set_match.what: Did the model select exactly the expected evidence turns?
compliance.evidence_exact_set_match.calculation: Share of checks whose selected turns equal the expected turns.
compliance.evidence_exact_set_match.important: Any extra or missing turn prevents an exact match.

compliance.invalid_evidence_reference_ra.label: Unmatched evidence references
compliance.invalid_evidence_reference_ra.what: How often did the model cite evidence that could not be matched to a transcript turn?
compliance.invalid_evidence_reference_ra.calculation: Checks with at least one unmatched evidence reference ÷ all compliance checks.

compliance.native_unclear_outputs.label: Raw UNCLEAR outputs
compliance.native_unclear_outputs.what: How often the pipeline's raw output was UNCLEAR, before separating genuine abstentions from failure fallbacks.
compliance.native_unclear_outputs.calculation: Raw UNCLEAR outputs ÷ all compliance checks.
compliance.native_unclear_outputs.important: Diagnostic only. Raw UNCLEAR = abstentions + failures that fell back to UNCLEAR.

compliance.native_unclear_prediction_fai.label: Raw UNCLEAR from failures
compliance.native_unclear_prediction_fai.what: How often a raw UNCLEAR output was really a fallback after a prediction failure.
compliance.native_unclear_prediction_fai.calculation: Failures whose raw output was UNCLEAR ÷ all compliance checks.

extraction.evidence_coverage.label: Extraction evidence coverage
extraction.evidence_coverage.what: When a value was expected, how often did the evidence selected by the model contain it?
extraction.evidence_coverage.calculation: Expected values located ÷ expected values the evaluator can check.
extraction.evidence_coverage.important: This shows whether the information was located, not whether a structured value was extracted correctly. Checks with no expected value are excluded; technically failed checks stay in the total.

extraction.prediction_failure_rate.label: Extraction failure rate
extraction.prediction_failure_rate.what: How often did an extraction check fail to produce a usable result because of a technical or output error?
extraction.prediction_failure_rate.calculation: Failed extraction checks ÷ all extraction checks.
extraction.prediction_failure_rate.important: Lower is better. Independent of whether values were located.

extraction.present_expected_values.label: Values expected
extraction.present_expected_values.what: Extraction checks where the ground truth contains a value.
extraction.present_expected_values.calculation: Count of checks with an expected value.

extraction.not_stated_expected_values.label: No value expected
extraction.not_stated_expected_values.what: Extraction checks where the ground truth intentionally contains no value.
extraction.not_stated_expected_values.calculation: Count of checks with no expected value.

extraction.found.label: Successfully located
extraction.found.what: Expected values that appear in the evidence selected by the model.

extraction.not_found.label: Not located
extraction.not_found.what: Checks that ran successfully, but whose selected evidence did not contain the expected value.
extraction.not_found.important: Technical failures are counted separately, not here.

extraction.unsupported.label: Cannot be checked
extraction.unsupported.what: Expected values of a type the evaluator cannot compare automatically.
extraction.unsupported.calculation: Count of values the evaluator cannot check.
extraction.unsupported.important: Not a model error. Excluded from coverage; shown only when non-zero.

extraction.evidence_precision.label: Extraction evidence precision
extraction.evidence_precision.what: Of the turns the model selected, how much matched the expected evidence turn?
extraction.evidence_precision.calculation: Averaged per check: matching turns ÷ turns selected.
extraction.evidence_precision.important: Use: shows whether the model cites turns beyond the one that states the value. Low precision means extra turns are cited, although the value can still be located.

extraction.evidence_recall.label: Extraction evidence recall
extraction.evidence_recall.what: Of the expected evidence turns, how many did the model select?
extraction.evidence_recall.calculation: Averaged per check: matching turns ÷ expected turns.
extraction.evidence_recall.important: Use: shows whether the model finds the turn where the value is stated. Low recall means that turn is being overlooked.

extraction.evidence_exact_set_match.label: Extraction exact evidence match
extraction.evidence_exact_set_match.what: Did the model select exactly the expected evidence turns?
extraction.evidence_exact_set_match.calculation: Share of checks whose selected turns equal the expected turns.
extraction.evidence_exact_set_match.important: Any extra or missing turn prevents an exact match.

extraction.invalid_evidence_reference_ra.label: Extraction unmatched evidence references
extraction.invalid_evidence_reference_ra.what: How often did the model cite evidence that could not be matched to a transcript turn?
extraction.invalid_evidence_reference_ra.calculation: Checks with at least one unmatched evidence reference ÷ all extraction checks.

extraction.native_unclear_outputs.label: Extraction raw UNCLEAR outputs
extraction.native_unclear_outputs.what: How often the pipeline's raw output for an extraction check was UNCLEAR.
extraction.native_unclear_outputs.calculation: Raw UNCLEAR outputs ÷ all extraction checks.
extraction.native_unclear_outputs.important: Not an abstention, and says nothing about whether the value was located.

diagnostic.evidence_all_questions_precis.label: Blended evidence precision
diagnostic.evidence_all_questions_precis.what: Evidence precision across both compliance and extraction checks.
diagnostic.evidence_all_questions_precis.calculation: Averaged per check across both families.
diagnostic.evidence_all_questions_precis.important: Kept for backward compatibility. Mixes families; prefer the per-family evidence metrics.

latency_total.label: Total run time
latency_total.what: How long the whole evaluation took.
latency_total.calculation: Time from the first call starting to scoring finishing.
latency_total.important: Response times vary from run to run, so small differences are noise.

latency_per_call.label: Average time per call
latency_per_call.what: How long the pipeline takes to analyse one call, on average.
latency_per_call.calculation: Sum of each call's time ÷ number of calls.

tokens_total.label: Tokens used
tokens_total.what: How much text the model read and wrote across the run.
tokens_total.calculation: Input tokens + output tokens, including retried attempts.
tokens_total.important: Counts the chat model only (embeddings are not included) and includes its internal reasoning. Shown as — for runs that did not record usage.

cost_total.label: Estimated cost
cost_total.what: The estimated model cost of the whole run.
cost_total.calculation: Tokens × the model's price per token at the time of the run.
cost_total.important: An estimate from list prices, not a bill. Shown as — when usage was not recorded or no price was configured.

cost_per_call.label: Estimated cost per call
cost_per_call.what: The estimated model cost of analysing one call, on average.
cost_per_call.calculation: Estimated run cost ÷ number of calls.
cost_per_call.important: An estimate from list prices, not a bill.

success.label: Completed
success.description: The pipeline returned a usable result.

prediction_failure.label: Prediction failed
prediction_failure.description: The pipeline did not return a usable result because of an error or invalid output.

analysis_unavailable.label: Analysis failed
analysis_unavailable.description: The analysis step hit an error and fell back to a placeholder result.

classification_unavailable.label: Classification failed
classification_unavailable.description: The pipeline could not classify this check.

missing_prediction.label: No result returned
missing_prediction.description: No result came back for this check, or the whole call failed.

duplicate_prediction.label: Duplicate results
duplicate_prediction.description: More than one result came back for this check.

malformed_verdict.label: Invalid verdict
malformed_verdict.description: The verdict was not PASS, FAIL, UNCLEAR or N/A.

malformed_evidence.label: Invalid evidence format
malformed_evidence.description: The evidence was not returned in the expected format.

binary_decision.label: PASS / FAIL decision
binary_decision.description: The system made a clear PASS or FAIL decision.

abstention.label: UNCLEAR
abstention.description: The analysis completed but did not reach a PASS/FAIL decision.

prediction_failure.label: Prediction failed
prediction_failure.description: The pipeline did not return a usable result.

unexpected_not_applicable.label: Marked N/A
unexpected_not_applicable.description: Marked not applicable, although every check is meant to apply.

detected.label: Caught
detected.description: An actual breach the system flagged as FAIL.

false_clearance.label: Falsely cleared
false_clearance.description: An actual breach the system marked PASS.

abstained.label: Left UNCLEAR
abstained.description: An actual breach the system did not decide.

prediction_failure.label: Prediction failed
prediction_failure.description: An actual breach the pipeline failed to assess.

unexpected_not_applicable.label: Marked N/A
unexpected_not_applicable.description: An actual breach marked not applicable.

PRESENT.label: Value expected
PRESENT.description: The ground truth contains a value for this field.

NOT_STATED.label: No value expected
NOT_STATED.description: The ground truth intentionally contains no value for this field, so this case is excluded from extraction coverage.

FOUND.label: Successfully located
FOUND.description: The expected value appears in the evidence selected by the model.

NOT_FOUND.label: Expected value not located
NOT_FOUND.description: A value was expected, but the model's selected evidence did not contain it.

SUPPORTED.label: Can be checked
SUPPORTED.description: The evaluator can compare this value type automatically.

UNSUPPORTED.label: Cannot be checked
UNSUPPORTED.description: The evaluator cannot compare this value type. This is not a model error.

scored.label: Scored
scored.description: All selected evidence matched transcript turns.

invalid_references.label: Unmatched evidence
invalid_references.description: Some selected evidence could not be matched to a transcript turn.

prediction_failure.label: No evidence (failed)
prediction_failure.description: The prediction failed, so evidence scores zero.

evidence_failure.label: Evidence unavailable
evidence_failure.description: The result had no usable evidence, so evidence scores zero.

completed.label: Complete
completed.description: Every call ran without errors or warnings.

completed_with_errors.label: Completed with issues
completed_with_errors.description: The run finished, but some calls produced pipeline warnings or prediction failures. All results remain part of the evaluation.

pipeline_diagnostic.label: Pipeline warning
pipeline_diagnostic.description: The pipeline recovered from a problem and kept going. Not a model decision.

prediction_failure.label: Prediction failed
prediction_failure.description: A check did not return a usable result.

duplicate_prediction.label: Duplicate results
duplicate_prediction.description: A check returned more than one result.

malformed_verdict.label: Invalid verdict
malformed_verdict.description: A check returned an unrecognised verdict.

malformed_evidence.label: Invalid evidence format
malformed_evidence.description: A check's evidence was not in the expected format.

invalid_evidence_reference.label: Unmatched evidence
invalid_evidence_reference.description: Some selected evidence could not be matched to a transcript turn.

graph_exception.label: Call failed
graph_exception.description: The pipeline raised an error for the whole call.

malformed_output.label: Invalid call output
malformed_output.description: The pipeline's output for the call was not in the expected shape.

malformed_finding.label: Invalid result
malformed_finding.description: A result had no checklist ID.

unexpected_prediction.label: Unexpected result
unexpected_prediction.description: The pipeline returned a result for a check not in the checklist.

evidence_parts.intro: Counts the turns the model cited as evidence.

precision.title: Extra turns the model cited
precision.what: Turns the model cited that were not expected. Each one lowers precision.
precision.by_rule_note: These score 0% because the model cited nothing. No turn was extra.

recall.title: Expected turns the model missed
recall.what: Expected turns the model did not cite. Each one lowers recall.
recall.by_rule_note: These score 0% because no evidence was expected. No turn was missed.

exact.title: Checks without an exact match
exact.what: Checks where the cited turns differ from the expected turns.

invalid.title: Unmatched evidence references
invalid.what: Evidence the model cited that matches no transcript turn.

unclear.title: Raw UNCLEAR outputs
unclear.what: Checks where the model's raw answer was UNCLEAR.

evidence_parts.breakdown_caption: {numerator} of {denominator} checks where evidence was expected
evidence_parts.breakdown_footnote: {all} across all {total} checks. The {none} checks that expect no evidence score 0% if the model cites any turn.
evidence_parts.breakdown_both: Where evidence was expected: {expected}. Where none was expected: {none}.
